items.title: John Beal interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2024
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe... Welcome, sir. [INTERVIEWEE] Thanks, Monk.

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very pleased to have bassist John Beal with me today. Welcome, sir.
Congratulations on your lengthy career. I assume you know a fellow named John Wasserman?
